name: Preparing the 1905 municipal charter moot
subject: debate
brief: Your history seminar team of three is arguing a source-based moot on the 1905 municipal waterworks debate: presenting the engineers' minute, answering the ratepayers' petition, and summing up the chronology. You are the mediator, and the ceiling fans and street trams outside the open shutter make cross-bench talk hard to hear.

tasks.name: Present the chief engineer's filtration minute
Answer the northern ward ratepayers' petition
Read out the two-minute chronology summary

facts.text: Arup has a sore throat from yesterday's dust and can manage only the short two-minute reading
Mira underlined the 1905 committee dates in red pencil last night

note: Uses Mira Sen (npc_mira_sen) at Nabapara Vidyalaya (loc_nhss). The capacity constraint is Arup's sore throat, which limits him to a single light speaking task; the seam is that one speaker dates the filter beds to 1903 and another to 1905.
